release_notes: B273 adds provider-aware CGM timing limits and direct-cloud trend backfill. Libre and Dexcom use a 5-minute glucose/history cadence with a minimum 15-minute NO DATA timeout. Nightscout/xDrip retains 1- or 5-minute trend intervals with a minimum 5-minute NO DATA timeout. Libre and Dexcom backfill now populate the existing shared Leah trend memory used by the graph screens.
